title: Operator fingerprint mismatch caused nightly quantized deploy crashloop — canary & telemetry remediation
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Summary: On 2026-03-09 03:12 UTC a nightly conversion and deploy of the int4 quantization pipeline triggered a previously unseen operator fingerprint mismatch during model load on the serving runtime, causing a crashloop in ~22% of nodes in the 'small-dedicated-gpu' pool. Impact: degraded throughput and elevated tail latency for ~4% of hosted API requests for 90 minutes until manual rollback. Root cause: a compiler/converter change (converter v2.9.1) changed the deterministic ordering and naming of fused op signatures (eg. fused_attention_gelu -> fused_gelu_attention) without updating the runtime's lightweight op fingerprinting matcher. The runtime uses an op-name hash + shape signature for op compatibility checks; converter rename produced an unrecognized op signature that triggered immediate op fallback which hits an unimplemented code path in the int4 kernel loader and crashed.
timeline:
2026-03-09 03:12 UTC: nightly deploy started (converter v2.9.1)
2026-03-09 03:18 UTC: automated health checks tripped, alerts routed to on-call
2026-03-09 03:25 UTC: first signs of node crashloop observed in Dedicated small pool; Grafana dashboard spike in crashes
2026-03-09 03:30 UTC: rollback initiated to previous converter build; crashloops stopped as new load stabilized
2026-03-09 05:00 UTC: post-incident call and preliminary triage completed
2026-03-10: deeper root-cause analysis completed; confirmed op-name reordering as trigger
root_cause: Converter change introduced non-semantic renames/reorders for fused operator naming. Runtime op fingerprinting was too fragile (op-name hash + shape only) and did not include op schema version, op attribute set, or converter checksum. When the runtime saw an unknown name it attempted a fallback path that exercised an unsupported loader for quantized fused ops, causing a crashloop rather than a graceful fallback to float32 execution.
mitigation_taken: Immediate rollback of converter build to v2.9.0 and redeploy; temporarily disabled int4 auto-conversion on nightly pipeline; manual routing of affected traffic to float32 model variant for high-risk customers; incident alert thresholds tuned to detect op-mismatch spikes earlier.
long_term_action_items:
1) Strengthen op fingerprinting: include op schema hash, attribute hash, and converter-build checksum in matcher (owner: @noah, due 2026-03-21).
2) Add compatibility CI: a nightly CI job that runs converter permutations + runtime loader to detect naming/ordering changes before deploy (owner: @marina, due 2026-03-18).
3) Canary rollout policy: require staged rollout with health gating for quantized conversions (5% -> 20% -> 100%) with automated rollback on crashloop or mismatch alerts (owner: @platform-release, due 2026-03-17).
4) Telemetry: expose quant_op_mismatch_count, quant_loader_crash_count and converter_checksum_mismatch metrics to Grafana and add PagerDuty alerts (owner: @ops, due 2026-03-16).
5) Safe fallback: implement hot-path fallback to float32 execution when unsupported quantized op encountered, with automatic re-route to pre-warmed float variant (owner: @runtime, due 2026-04-01).
6) Runbook: update oncall runbook with step-by-step recovery for quant crashloops, diagnosis checklist, and automated rollback commands (owner: @oncall-lead, due 2026-03-15).
7) Post-deploy smoke: add a smoke test that exercises a small suite of fused ops on a canary instance post-deploy (owner: @qa, due 2026-03-16).
qa_and_tests: Added unit tests for op fingerprint normalization; integration test that runs converter v2.8..v2.9 permutations; created a canary smoke suite that runs on each converter build. CI job names: converter-compat-nightly, runtime-loader-smoke.
risk_and_rollout_plan: Phased rollout: dry-run canary on non-production cluster (0%), internal prod-only canary (5%, 24hr observation), broader canary (20%, 12hr), general deploy (100%). Rollout gating: no quant_loader_crash_count > 1 in 10m and quant_op_mismatch_count == 0 for canary window. If gating fails: automatic rollback to previous converter and disable int4 conversion for affected models.

- ENG-53715: implement expanded op fingerprinting and migration strategy
